headword: {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}

definitions.explanation: A small, cross-shaped constellation visible in the Southern Hemisphere, used there as a guide for locating due south.

examples.japanese: {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たい→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I want to see the Southern Cross.

examples.japanese: ⟦{南半球|みなみはんきゅう}→南半球：19054_minamihankyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The Southern Cross is easily seen in the Southern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: {船乗|ふなの}りたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、{南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}り→頼り：14634_tayori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}った→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: In the past, sailors relied on the Southern Cross to find their direction.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧ (south) + {十字星|じゅうじせい} (cross star). The constellation, formally {南十字座|みなみじゅうじざ} (Crux), is not visible from most of Japan and is a famous symbol of the southern sky.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see the Southern Cross
- {南十字星|みなみじゅうじせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for the Southern Cross

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{北斗|ほくと}{七星|しちせい}→北斗七星：29539_hokutoshichisei⟧: the Big Dipper — the prominent northern-sky asterism
